stem.text: What is meant by the mass and by the weight of an object on the Earth?

A.text: its momentum divided by its velocity; the work done in lifting it one metre

B.text: the gravitational force on it; the property that resists its acceleration

C.text: the pull of the Earth on it; its mass divided by the acceleration of free fall

D.text: the property that resists its acceleration; the pull of the Earth on it

A: its momentum divided by its velocity
the work done in lifting it one metre
B: the property that resists its acceleration
C: the pull of the Earth on it
its mass divided by the acceleration of free fall
D: the property that resists its acceleration
the pull of the Earth on it
